definitions: A Japanese historical manga series written and illustrated by Makoto Yukimura, serialized in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine before moving to the monthly seinen magazine Afternoon.
An anime television series adaptation of the manga, produced by Wit Studio (season 1) and MAPPA (season 2-present).
examples: Have you read the latest chapter of Vinland Saga?
The animation in Vinland Saga is stunning.
Vinland Saga explores themes of war, peace, and revenge.
